cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Name My Contribution
cards.instruction: Get them to acknowledge exactly what your effort, sacrifice, or strategy added to the result.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before you thank the trip committee, say what my red bookings list did for us.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You copied my red font. Mine marked cancellations; you colored every booking red.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally, all checked. Say I made the whole list impossible to overlook.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The hotel rang about your 'cancellations.' We found three missing rooms during the call.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Say my list led us to those three rooms. Not just 'helped with admin.'

cardFidelity.evidence: B2 exposes copied cancellation formatting; A3 denies confusion through all-checked language while seeking credit, then A5 names the actual recovered rooms.

heightening.evidence: A5 abandons generic thoroughness and requests the concrete benefit disclosed by B4.

brevityWit.evidence: A5 three rooms rather than admin is concise, specific acknowledgment directed at B.
